name: Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall (Taipei)
scope: Main memorial hall, broad sweeping tiled roof, colonnaded elevations and immediate terrace; exclude park grounds.
era: surviving exterior represented by selected dated references

review.method: Qualla-first corpus search followed by exact named photographer Ownwork/self-CC0 originals, primary release/native bytes and current model comparison.
review.notes: The exact Nesnad2011CC0 original confirms the broad square memorial hall, flat red central roof deck, four concave yellow-tiled slopes with sharply raised corners and dark gray deep fascia, projecting higher south entrance roof, gray open colonnades and immediate raised terrace. Current whole, roof, front, curled-corner, colonnade and north-return renders retain these identifying forms at medium-fi scope. Fine roof tiles/brackets, hidden walls/window grids, exact terrace/stair dimensions and current condition remain architectural estimates. The surrounding park, pools, modern neighbors, visitors, guard displays, interiors and sculpture are excluded. No reference pixels are embedded.
